About Belarus Overview

MBBS in Belarus

Belarus, or officially known as the Republic of Belarus, is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe. Bordering Russia towards the northeast, Ukraine to the south, Poland to the west, and Lithuania and Latvia to the northwest, Belarus is a country with a rich history, culture, and nature.

Minsk, the capital, is the largest and most significant city in Belarus, representing a lively cultural and educational hub with several of the top medical colleges. Belarus holds an enlightening culture showing the traditions and customs of Eastern Europeans and Slavic people.

Belarus is home to some fantastically beautiful sceneries: the forests, lakes, and rivers. It provides safe and enriching experiences for students, with highly valued cultural heritage blending with natural beauty, world-class higher education, and a diverse study environment.

Why Study MBBS in Belarus?

Quality medical education at an affordable cost

It is very wise to choose MBBS in Belarus for international students in order to get quality medical education at an affordable cost. Belarus has a number of advantages that make it a very attractive destination.

01

Low Tuition Fees: There are very nominal tuition fees charged. The fee structure is so affordable that it turns out to be an ideal destination for those who cannot afford higher fees in India.

02

High-Quality Education: Most of the universities offer internationally recognized degrees with modern curricula, well-equipped labs, and experienced faculty members. Many universities are in the WHO directory.

03

English-Medium Programs: Universities offer English medium for international students. This makes it easy for students unfamiliar with Russian to pursue studies without language barriers.

04

Cultural Experience & Safety: Living in Belarus is a great cultural experience, combining centuries of history with hospitable people. It is generally a safe country with low crime rates.

All Requirements for MBBS in Belarus

Understand the essential criteria and requirements

Ensure your eligibility for pursuing MBBS and starting your medical journey.

Eligibility Criteria to Apply

To secure MBBS admission in Belarus, students must meet the following criteria:

  • The candidate must have passed the 12th standard with PCB from a recognized board.
  • Minimum of 50% marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology combined.
  • Applicants must have studied English as a subject in their high school education.
  • Age should be at least 17 years by 31st December of the year of admission.
  • NEET qualification is required for Indian students.

Required Documents & Intake

The main intake for MBBS admissions in Belarus is September, with applications generally open from April to August.

Documents Needed:

  • Valid passport (at least two years validity).
  • 12th grade mark sheet & Transfer/Migration certificate.
  • NEET Score Card photocopy.
  • Birth Certificate & 10-12 Passport-Sized Photographs.
  • Medical Fitness Certificate & Proof of Funds.

Campus Life & Living Expenses

Cost of Living Approximately ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 per month.

The cost of living in Belarus is relatively affordable. Students may require $300 to $500 per month to cover basic expenses. Hostel fees range from $50 to $100 per month, while private apartments cost between $200 to $350 per month.

Food expenses are reasonable, with monthly food costs averaging around $100 to $150. Public transportation is affordable and well-organized, with monthly passes costing approximately $10 to $15. Indian food options and cultural events make it easy for Indian students to adjust.

Pathway Particulars

Duration & Structure

The MBBS program in Belarus typically lasts 6 years, including both theoretical studies and clinical training. This also includes a 1-year internship.

Medium of Teaching

The medium of instruction for international students is English, although some universities may offer bilingual programs in English and Russian. Knowledge of Russian or Belarusian is desirable for daily communication.

MBBS Admission In Belarus

A step-by-step roadmap to admission

The admission process for MBBS in Belarus is simple and student-friendly with the support of educational consultants.

  1. Submit Application: Submit academic documents for evaluation. There is no entrance examination for admission to VSMU, though a short assessment may occur.
  2. University Review: Receive assistance in the application process to top Belarusian medical universities.
  3. Offer Letter: The university issues an admission letter.
  4. Visa Process: Proceed with visa documentation, medical tests, and other formalities. Make sure visa applications are submitted well in advance.
  5. Travel: Receive travel assistance and pre-departure support before heading to Belarus.

Scholarships for MBBS in Belarus

Several universities in Belarus offer partial scholarships or fee reductions to international students based on academic excellence.

  • Coverage: These scholarships may cover tuition fees, accommodation support, or living expenses.
  • Eligibility: Generally depends on past academic performance, entrance exams, and university-specific criteria.
  • Application: Students can apply through their respective universities or education consultants.

Career Opportunities After MBBS

Medical degrees from Belarus are globally recognized, helping students secure good job opportunities worldwide.

  • Practice in India: Indian students can pursue medical licensing exams such as FMGE/NExT.
  • Global Exams: Appear for USMLE (USA), PLAB (UK), or practice in various Gulf and European countries.
  • Higher Studies: Graduates can also choose to continue studying through PG medical programs abroad.
MBBS in Belarus Syllabus

Comprehensive medical curriculum

Here is a breakdown of the syllabus year by year.

1st Year

Anatomy, Histology, Biochemistry, Medical Biology.

2nd Year

Physiology, Pathology, Microbiology, Pharmacology.

3rd Year

General Medicine, Pathophysiology, Immunology, Clinical Medicine Basics.

4th Year

Surgery, Internal Medicine, Obstetrics, Gynecology, Pediatrics.

5th & 6th Year

5th Year: Orthopedics, Ophthalmology, ENT, Dermatology, Psychiatry.
6th Year: Clinical Rotations, Internship, Emergency Medicine.

Comparing MBBS in Belarus Vs MBBS in India

Side-by-side decision matrix

01

MBBS in India

  • Course Duration: 5.5 Years.
  • Admission Process: Highly competitive, limited seats. High NEET score required.
  • Tuition Fees: Very high in private colleges, moderate in government colleges.
  • Clinical Exposure: Good but begins later compared to Belarus.
  • International Exposure: Limited international exposure. PG opportunities mostly India focused.
02

MBBS in Belarus

  • Course Duration: 6 Years.
  • Admission Process: Direct admission after NEET. Low competition level.
  • Tuition Fees: Affordable, generally lower than India.
  • Clinical Exposure: Early and practical oriented.
  • International Exposure: High, multicultural environment. Can apply for USMLE, PLAB, NExT.
